stagnation.policy: Detection/reporting always enabled. Stopping disabled by default; maximum candidate attempts unchanged.

config.source_grounding: Original source plus ontology/representation only; model judgments remain interpretations
config.candidate_attempt_definition: Initial generation plus every code revision. Reviewer format retries are separate.

provider_capabilities.verification: Upstream Azure documented; Aalto gateway/model capability unverified. No online capability probe.

token_limits.provider_limit_evidence: GET /v1/models confirmed model identity but did not expose limits or template; full provider framing/limit unknown
token_limits.count_contract: Verified o200k_harmony encoding of every supplied text block. Full provider-added framing is not exposed; text count is a lower bound, not proof of exact complete input count.

authorization: OFFLINE_READINESS_ONLY. No model calls authorized by this artifact; launch requires explicit user execution/authorization.
evaluation_policy: Same unchanged-shape execution for both arms; raw behavior and scope-qualified credit separate; no scope violation suppressed; all candidates diagnostic; selection frozen before evaluation
final_review: Existing deterministic terminal handoff; no extra model call, human arm or repair
review_budget_scope: Bounded development setting including reasoning; not a guarantee of sufficient output
readiness_criterion: Final offline software controls pass and source/schema/scope resolve; no new live operational or accuracy claim.

prior_exposure.TRF-035: Previously included in the five-requirement development set; not held out. Selection is source/schema/scope based; no saved candidate, review, repair solution or performance imported.

repair_exercise_policy: Fresh one-call shared generation. No forced code issue/repair; early approval or genuine context-pending is a result. No regeneration/manual edits/preferred-result rerun.
selection_basis: TRF-035 has an approved distinction between a recorded quantity and separately supplied society reference, explicit direct owner mappings, and canonical quantity encoding. This isolates handoff/citation/operand roles without the unresolved IMO design-intent equivalence.
question_carryforward_policy: Only questions validated during the new diagnostic; never import historical questions or solutions.
exercise_policy: No forced issue/repair/approval; early stopping. Unexercised semantic repair is NOT_EXERCISED. No regeneration/manual edits/preferred-result rerun.
